5 DM Templates That Get 40%+ Reply Rates

Copy-and-customise Instagram DM templates for collaborations, sales and networking — plus why each one works.

By ColdNerd Team · March 5, 2025 · 5 min read

A great template is a starting point, not a script. The templates below are built on patterns that consistently earn replies: they're short, specific and about the recipient. Always personalise the bracketed parts — that's where the magic happens.

1. The genuine compliment

Hey [Name]! Just watched your Reel on [topic] — the part about [specific detail] was spot on. Have you always approached it that way?

Why it works: it proves you actually looked at their content and ends with an easy question.

2. The collaboration opener

Hi [Name], love what you're building with [brand/account]. Our audiences overlap a lot around [shared topic]. Would you be open to a quick collab idea? Happy to share it here.

Why it works: it frames mutual benefit and asks permission before pitching.

3. The value-first offer

Hey [Name] — I put together a short checklist on [problem they have]. Thought it might help with [their goal]. Want me to send it over?

Why it works: it leads with a free, relevant resource and a yes/no question.

4. The mutual connection

Hi [Name], saw we both follow [mutual account] and you're working on [project]. I'm doing something similar with [your thing] — how are you finding [specific challenge]?

Why it works: shared context lowers the "who is this?" barrier.

5. The friendly follow-up

Hey [Name], bumping this in case it got buried 🙂 No worries if now's not the right time!

Why it works: many replies arrive on the follow-up, and this one is polite, short and pressure-free.

Tips to push reply rates higher

  • Keep the first message under 300 characters.
  • Never pitch a product in the first message.
  • Send when your audience is active — usually evenings and weekends for consumers, weekday mornings for B2B.
  • Vary wording between recipients so messages never look copy-pasted.

With ColdNerd you can save templates with personalisation variables, rotate variations automatically and schedule follow-ups — so every prospect gets a message that feels one-to-one.
